rationale: After gapping up to $11.89 on earnings, the stock has faded nearly $1.40 to sit at 4% of its daily range ($10.52), well below VWAP ($10.96) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($10.57). However, 1-minute volume has dried up to a few thousand shares during the midday session with a relatively wide 19 bps spread, making a short entry right above prior-day resistance ($10.41) poor reward-to-risk and a long entry against the prevailing downtrend premature. Given the tight remaining daily loss budget ($242.07), passing on this low-liquidity midday consolidation is optimal.
